This software uses libraries from the FFmpeg project (https://ffmpeg.org/),
licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 or later.
FFmpeg remains copyright its respective contributors; Last Raven's MIT
license does not replace FFmpeg's license.

This build contains libavcodec and libavutil, with ATRAC3 and ATRAC3+ decoding.
The FFmpeg source is unmodified. GPL, nonfree and version-3-only components,
external-library autodetection, and unrelated codecs are disabled.

The distribution's source/ directory contains the exact upstream source
archive, the build recipe and build information. Copying the library binaries
alone is not the complete distribution; keep the notices and license, and
provide equivalent access to the corresponding source alongside downloads.

You may replace the shared libraries with modified, interface-compatible
versions. The application must permit their use and must not prohibit
modification for your own use or reverse engineering to debug modifications.
See COPYING.LGPLv2.1 for the full terms.
